author: Bobby Grayson
description: Symptom: pillTouches threw on NaN ids, aborting applyState before scrollTo, so selecting a node never panned the map. Separately, the title placeholder collided with the JS global of the same name in the exported file; the export now replaces only the <title> element.
title: A shared CSS class between the sidebar mode badge and the SVG reasoning pills broke selection scrolling and search; scoping selectors to g.pill fixed both
